formation.note: No fetched source states an explicit collaboration formation date; the official site names founders Gianpaolo Bellini and Frank Calaprice without a date.

intervals.label: collaboration active
intervals.note: Start taken as a lower bound (start of detector R&D); end taken from the detector's shutdown date.
intervals.quote: In 1990, the design was fundamentally altered, and the name of the experiment was changed to "Borexino". Research and development began on the detector at that time. ... The entire Borexino experiment was terminated in October 2021.

intervals.label: collaboration completed (data taking)
intervals.note: The collaboration continues final-dataset analysis and publication (e.g. a 2026 nonstandard-interactions paper per the official site) after the detector itself was shut down; this terminal event marks the end of data-taking, not necessarily of the collaboration's activity.
intervals.quote: the entire Borexino experiment was terminated in October 2021
